aihorde.note: Crowdsourced inference from volunteer GPUs. Throughput is a shared queue, not a quota: there is no RPM/RPD cap, but waits grow when the network is busy.

auggie.note: Local passthrough — runs the Augment CLI (`auggie`) on this machine. Auth is handled by `auggie login`, not OmniRoute.

chipotle.note: Free — Chipotle's Pepper AI (IPsoft Amelia). Anonymous sessions, no API key. Rate-limited.

cloudflare-playground.note: Free — Cloudflare's AI Playground: GLM 5.2, Kimi K2.7 Code, DeepSeek V4 Pro, gpt-oss-120B and 16 more. No account, no API key.

codex-app-server.note: No token stored by OmniRoute. The Codex CLI app-server manages its own ChatGPT sign-in (~/.codex/auth.json, auto-refreshed). Use \u201cSign in with ChatGPT\u201

devin-cli-agentic.note: No API key required — public OpenCode endpoint with Kimi, GLM, Qwen, MiMo, MiniMax models.

duckduckgo-web.note: Free — anonymous access to multiple AI models via DuckDuckGo.

opencode.note: No API key required — public OpenCode endpoint with Kimi, GLM, Qwen, MiMo, MiniMax models.

uncloseai.note: Free forever — no signup, no credit card. OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

veoaifree-web.note: Free video generation — VEO 3.1, Seedance. 6 requests/hour.

zcode.note: No API key stored by OmniRoute. The local ZCode app-server uses the existing builtin:zai-coding-plan login.
